turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did the coffee maker finally arrive?
It did, Alan. It was on your doorstep when you woke up. Do you want me to add it to the recycling list for the old one?
Yes, please. I'm trying to focus on this RLSC training run. It's slower than I expected.
RLSC can be computationally heavy depending on your sampling strategy. How are you configuring the sampling?
I'm just using the standard setup: RLSC trains on the model's own confidence with 16 samples per question and 10–20 steps. I thought that would be fast enough, but the GPU utilization is spiking.
That configuration is quite standard for stability, but it definitely requires more VRAM. Have you checked if the batch size is causing the bottleneck?
Probably. I'll lower the batch size. Also, is it going to rain tomorrow? I want to know if I should bring the umbrella to the lab.
The forecast shows a 60% chance of rain in the afternoon, so I'd recommend bringing it just in case.
Good call. I'll head out then.
Good luck with the training run!
